name: The Type 2 Charstring Format
statement: Type 2 charstrings: the cubic Bezier outline operators (rmoveto, rlineto, rrcurveto, endchar) and number encoding of CFF glyphs. Its notice forbids reproduction, so it is cited only; the PDF retrieved on 2026-11-27 has SHA-256 74e77442e63e38f03f2be5a41d2dafb3076260d2b6cd9b9d14f3990d6e17102b.
